summary.en: Ayumi and the Detective Boys see an olive tree, on which lives a family of caterpillars. In the same area there is a murder, and a boy, despite having seen the face of the murderer, makes no statement to the police. Conan, after talking with the boy, is unable to understand why the boy does not want to talk to the authorities. Location: Shimura's house Cause of death: Stab wound Suspects: Senkichi Matsuura and Minoru Yoshikawa A robbery-murder of a man only known by his sur-name.
